source: Renesas, SH-1/SH-2/SH-DSP Software Manual, instruction descriptions and instruction code table: https://www.renesas.com/en/document/mah/sh-1sh-2sh-dsp-software-manual

cases.name: bra_forward
cases.formula: 1010 dddd dddd dddd; instruction address + 4 + sign_extend(disp12)*2

cases.name: bra_backward
cases.formula: 1010 dddd dddd dddd; instruction address + 4 + sign_extend(0xffe)*2

cases.name: mov_w_pc
cases.formula: 1001 nnnn dddd dddd; instruction address + 4 + disp8*2

cases.name: mov_indirect
cases.formula: 0110 nnnn mmmm 0010; n=0,m=1; long indirect load

cases.name: mov_store_indirect
cases.formula: 0010 nnnn mmmm 0010; n=0,m=1; long indirect store

cases.name: mov_predecrement
cases.formula: 0010 nnnn mmmm 0110; n=15,m=1; long predecrement store

cases.name: mov_postincrement
cases.formula: 0110 nnnn mmmm 0110; n=1,m=15; long postincrement load

cases.name: mov_indexed
cases.formula: 0000 nnnn mmmm 1110; n=0,m=6; long R0-indexed load

cases.name: mov_displacement
cases.formula: 0101 nnnn mmmm dddd; n=2,m=1,d=3; displacement scaled by 4

cases.name: invalid_sh2_fpu
cases.formula: 1111 encoding belongs to later FPU extensions, not SH-2
